headline: The Bull Case For Hilton Worldwide Holdings (HLT) Could Change Following Strong Q2 2026 Results And Upgraded Guidance
summary: Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results showing higher revenue of US$3,341 million and net income of US$482 million year over year, while its board authorized a regular quarterly cash dividend of US$0.15 per share payable on September 30, 2026. The company also projected higher diluted EPS and net income for the third quarter and full year 2026 and disclosed that, since 2017, it has repurchased 99,277,992 shares for US$14.67 billion, reinforcing its asset-light,...
